up: Return the first 1000 activity rows for target CHEMBL3898 (Bone morphogenetic protein 1) where the standard_type is 'IC50', standard_relation is '=' (exact), and pChEMBL value is not null. Include only human single-protein targets. For each row, return: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target_info AS (SELECT tid, chembl_id, target_type, tax_id FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3898' AND target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND tax_id = 9606) SELECT td.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_info td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, td.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
